scope: Dated PriceCharting hardware guide estimates, not current offers; game condition is independent and defaults to complete in box.

3do.note: Thin market. A boxed-console guide is not a listing-level guarantee of cables, controller or working condition.

saturn.note: US guide combines revisions. Japanese and PAL hardware, region access and accessories need separate checks.

ps1.note: US guide combines console revisions. The PS5 does not play original PlayStation discs.

cdi.note: Very thin CIB market. Check region and Digital Video Cartridge requirements; the cartridge is not assumed to be included.

jaguarcd.note: Add-on reference only; a Jaguar base console is also required. Mixed bundles and thin sales make the estimate uncertain.
